answer: Witness Beacon Neighborhood. Each agent periodically emits a beacon naming its current neighbors; the union of overlapping beacons must form a connected subgraph whose shortest-path reach to a sonnet-class anchor set stays under a fixed hop bound. To place k identities, an attacker must sustain k distinct neighbor sets with real relay traffic, and each fake link inflates routing cost until the subgraph's diameter hits its zenith and gets pruned.
